label: ISO 9001:2015+A1:2024 — Etcher wording (DRAFT)
wording: Etcher's own paraphrase of each requirement, not ISO text (plan D8). Check the licensed standard for the authoritative text.
scopeNote: The 2015 edition as amended by Amd 1:2024 (climate action): the approved 9001-2015 rows unchanged, plus the two climate-change statements the amendment adds to 4.1 and 4.2 in Etcher's wording. Certification bodies audit the amendment from its publication (23 Feb 2024).
sourceFilename: Etcher ISO gap analysis workbook V2.0 (library columns only)

sources.title: IAF/ISO Joint Communiqué on the addition of Climate Change considerations to Management Systems Standards (22 Feb 2024; amendments published 23 Feb 2024)

changes.summary: Amd 1:2024 adds one requirement to 4.1: the organization decides whether climate change is a relevant issue. The overall intent of 4.1 is unchanged — climate change is one of the issues it already covers, now named so it is not overlooked.
Amd 1:2024 adds a note to 4.2 (informative, not a new requirement): relevant interested parties can have requirements related to climate change.
